trace_definition: GammaS = 16 pi^2 tr gamma_S at one loop, canonical W ⊃ Y_iaI 5bar_i 5_a S_I. Each SU(5) component separately contributes ||Y||^2, multiplicity 5.
scope: Single simple SU(5), three families, one even adjoint, four vectorlike five pairs, no other interacting chiral matter. Renormalizable superpotential, ordinary matter parity. Perturbative, conventional signal origin, color-, electromagnetism-, B-L-preserving vacuum and soft terms. Numerical examples take matching factors R=A=1.
